verdict.rationale: Nothing from the Secretary of State's own site was readable: both ohiosos.gov and the Business Central filing portal returned 403 at robots.txt, so the pack holds no SoS guidance content at all. What remains comes from other state surfaces. The Ohio Business Gateway offers portal login and navigation 'tips and guides', and the Department of Taxation runs a small-business tax course series. Both belong to other agencies or the host platform, and neither shows the SoS publishing plain-language, step-by-step explainers for a founder's filing task, so they earn no credit.
